method: ReleaseSafe on development macOS host; one warmup and 20 samples. Logical read/probe counters are not backing-file reads. Fixture timings are not production throughput or RSS; other compilation jobs ran concurrently. Mapping scratch is lazily allocated and bounded to 512 bytes per active ranged-map iterator, and participates in the existing workspace retention budget. Short-block comparison uses the parent fixed-span implementation (3096 bytes) versus an exact one-row lookahead (24 bytes), excluding the first point lookup shared by both.
